items.title: DeepSeek search and fetch – $0.75 per 1000 successful requests
items.summary: DeepSeek has introduced a new search and fetch API that charges $0.75 for every 1000 successful requests. This cost-effective solution allows developers to integrate advanced search capabilities into their applications without incurring high expenses.

items.title: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
items.summary: Sphinx is a new tool designed to quiz developers on their AI code before deployment, ensuring better understanding and fewer errors. This innovative approach could significantly improve code quality and reduce the risk of deploying faulty AI systems.

items.title: NY announces game ownership bill requiring ownership rather than licensing
items.summary: New York has proposed a game ownership bill that mandates consumers own their games outright instead of merely licensing them. This legislation could reshape the gaming landscape, impacting developers and consumers alike by ensuring long-term access to purchased games.

items.title: Lean now ships with verified kernels
items.summary: The Lean theorem prover has announced the inclusion of verified kernels, enhancing its reliability and trustworthiness for developers. This update is crucial for those in formal verification and mathematical proof development, as it ensures higher confidence in the tools they use.

items.title: Interactive Linear Programming in the Browser
items.summary: A new web application allows users to perform interactive linear programming directly in their browsers, making complex optimization tasks more accessible. This tool can significantly benefit engineers and data scientists by simplifying the modeling and solving of linear programming problems.
